name: Gardien de la préséance
description: A broad muscular middle-aged male chief with dark forest-green marbled skin, a high rounded forehead and short thick grey-tipped dreads. A distinctive symmetrical fan of small bone blades across the upper shoulder mantle, long brown-green ceremonial skirt and multiple bronze waist bands. Hands crossed low at the belt. Dignified static stance, full clawed toes and all bone ornaments visible.
